title: Brand rollout, first-class plus-ones, registry & go-live
problem_statement: Sprint 1 shipped a working but unbranded gate: the theme palette and fonts are placeholders, named plus-ones are not first-class Guests, there is no registry link or QR code, the admin invited-vs-replied roster is not built, and the live apex serves http without forcing HTTPS so browsers show "not secure".
solution: Apply an invitation-derived color palette and a harmonized type scale, make named plus-ones first-class Guests via idempotent RSVP write-back, add the registry link and a themed QR code, ship the admin invited-vs-replied roster, force HTTPS with HSTS, and verify the rebranded gated site live on angelaandbrooks.com.

user_stories.want: the gate and site to carry Angela & Brooks's invitation branding
user_stories.benefit: the site feels like part of their wedding, not a placeholder.

user_stories.want: named plus-ones to appear as real Guests on the Guest List with stable ids
user_stories.benefit: we can see and manage everyone actually attending in one place.

user_stories.want: a registry link on the Registry page
user_stories.benefit: I can find where to send a gift.

user_stories.want: a QR code that opens the live wedding site
user_stories.benefit: I can reach it without typing the URL.

user_stories.want: the site served securely over HTTPS
user_stories.benefit: my browser does not warn that it is not secure.

user_stories.want: an admin roster showing invited versus replied
user_stories.benefit: we can track who has responded.

user_stories.want: the rebranded gated site verified live on angelaandbrooks.com
user_stories.benefit: we can share the real wedding URL with confidence.

implementation_decisions.title: Named plus-ones become first-class Guests via idempotent RSVP write-back (ADR 019eebb3-f8db)
implementation_decisions.summary: At submit, a named plus-one is minted a guest_id (stamped on its rsvps row) and appended to the Guest List with the host's party_id and side, plus_one_allowed FALSE, and a new additive source column (blank=invitation, "plus-one"=RSVP-added). Idempotent on (party_id + normalized name). This supersedes the Sprint-1 PRD's out-of-scope on write-back and ADR 019eeb28's is_plus_one-derived-from-empty-guest_id; is_plus_one is now source=="plus-one". Supersession is noted on ADR 019eeb28 and CONTEXT.md, not rewritten.

implementation_decisions.title: angelaandbrooks.com served via a Cloudflare Workers Custom Domain (ADR 019eebb3-fedc)
implementation_decisions.summary: Bind the apex and www to the existing Worker as custom_domain in wrangler.jsonc so the binding is version-controlled and re-applied on every deploy; Cloudflare provisions the DNS record and edge cert. Reversible, and the workers.dev URL stays as a fallback.

implementation_decisions.title: Invitation-derived palette and harmonized type scale
implementation_decisions.summary: Replace the nine theme color roles with values sampled from the invitation proof (Final-Proof-For-Zazzle.png), and introduce a font-size token type scale adopted across components, folding backlog issue 019eeb89 and removing the pre-existing Georgia, serif fallback. Tokens-only; no hardcoded colors or font sizes.

implementation_decisions.title: Hero photo cropped and optimized under the Cloudflare asset limit
implementation_decisions.summary: The 28MB portrait original is cropped to 16:9 and optimized to <=2000px / <=500KB for the committed public/hero.jpg; the original is preserved under docs/source_material/ to stay well under Cloudflare's 25MB limit.

implementation_decisions.title: Force HTTPS at the app layer
implementation_decisions.summary: Middleware issues a 308 redirect from http to https using x-forwarded-proto and sets a Strict-Transport-Security header, resolving the not-secure warning on the live apex.

implementation_decisions.title: Registry link with an optional reversible embed
implementation_decisions.summary: Add a tokens-only registry link/button to the couple's myregistry URL (new tab, rel noopener noreferrer); add an embed/widget only if reversible and low-risk, else document it as deferred.

testing_decisions: Unit tests cover plus-one guest_id minting, idempotency on (party_id + normalized name), Guest List write-back, and the source-aware Guest List reader.
Contrast is re-checked on the new palette: AAA text-primary over background, AA primary over background.
Live smoke test on https://angelaandbrooks.com: the gate name screen renders (200), /admin reaches admin auth, TLS is valid, and no not-secure warning appears.
Token-style adherence is extended to and passes on the new color and font-size tokens; content-fidelity passes on the registry copy.
out_of_scope: Venue search and any venue-selection work (always out of scope for a website sprint).
Guest List structural redesign beyond the additive source column.
A myregistry embed/widget unless it is reversible and low-risk.
Disabling the workers.dev fallback URL after cutover.
notes: ADR 019eebb3-f8db supersedes ADR 019eeb28's is_plus_one rule and the Sprint-1 PRD's write-back out-of-scope; CONTEXT.md term updates for source / is_plus_one land with issue 019eebbd-b09e (the +1 write-back slice).
